name: Acadesine
aliases: AIC-Riboside, AICA-riboside, AICAr, AR-100, EC Number 220-097-5, GP 1-110, GP-1-110, SCH-900395
summary: Acadesine (INN), also known as 5-aminoimidazole-4-carboxamide-1-β-D-ribofuranoside, AICA-riboside, and AICAR, is an AMP-activated protein kinase activator which is used for the treatment of acute lymphoblastic leukemia and may have applications in treating other disorders such as diabetes. Acadesine has been used clinically to treat and protect against cardiac ischemic injury.

pharmacology.text: Acadesine acts as an AMP-activated protein kinase agonist. It stimulates glucose uptake and increases the activity of p38 mitogen-activated protein kinases α and β in skeletal muscle tissue, as well as suppressing apoptosis by reducing production of reactive oxygen compounds inside the cell.

uses.text: Acadesine (INN), also known as 5-aminoimidazole-4-carboxamide-1-β-D-ribofuranoside, AICA-riboside, and AICAR, is an AMP-activated protein kinase activator which is used for the treatment of acute lymphoblastic leukemia and may have applications in treating other disorders such as diabetes. Acadesine has been used clinically to treat and protect against cardiac ischemic injury.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. In studies it has caused raised uric acid levels in the blood, headache and changes in heart rhythm.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。在研究中，它曾造成血中尿酸升高、頭痛與心律改變。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。在研究中，它曾造成血中尿酸升高、头痛与心律改变。

fact.en: Every cell in the body makes the same molecule, minus its sugar, as a step in building the DNA bases. Inside cells it turns into a mimic of AMP, the signal that tells a cell it is short of energy.
fact.zh: 體內每個細胞都會製造這個分子（去掉糖的部分），作為合成DNA鹼基的一個步驟。進入細胞後，它會轉變成AMP的模擬物，而AMP正是告訴細胞能量不足的訊號。
fact.zhHans: 体内每个细胞都会制造这个分子（去掉糖的部分），作为合成DNA碱基的一个步骤。进入细胞后，它会转变成AMP的仿真物，而AMP正是告诉细胞能量不足的信号。
